meta.title: The drawer is read-only when the project came from a PR
gaps: Creating a project through the PR→event path or verifying that an existing project originated from a PR; the required existing PR-created project must be supplied.
Checking that both add and remove controls are disabled: their exact control labels are not supplied, and an addition refusal alone does not prove both controls are disabled.
Attempting removal and verifying that the complete item list remains unchanged; no removal step or confirmed item-list target is supplied.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Creating a project through the PR→event path or verifying that an existing project originated from a PR; the required existing PR-created project must be supplied.; Checking that both add and remove controls are disabled: their exact control labels are not supplied, and an addition refusal alone does not prove both controls are disabled.; Attempting removal and verifying that the complete item list remains unchanged; no removal step or confirmed item-list target is supplied.

steps.note: Open the required existing PR-created project; do not substitute an ordinary newly created event.
Open the Manage Line Items drawer.
Verify that the requested drawer is visible.
Require positive evidence that adding an item is refused; an executor failure is not a passing restriction check.
Record the drawer for inspection of removal controls and the fixed list; this evidence is not an assertion.
